text: ポケモンしょうぶで　にげだそうと　するとは　なにごとじゃ！

structure.jp: にげだそうと　するとは
structure.en: to think you would try to run away
what is the meaning of this!

patterns.name: 〜ようとする
patterns.span: にげだそうと　する
patterns.explanation: The おう form of a verb plus とする means 'try to do' or 'be about to do'. にげだそうと　する = 'try to run away'.

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは after an action shows shock or anger at it, like 'to think that you would'. にげだそうと　するとは = 'to think you would try to run away'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'it is'. Professor Oak talks this way. なにごとじゃ = 'what is this!'.
